_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-05-12 01:57:47Z)**_

Found it. Those aren't D source files — they're Cargo's `.d` dependency manifest files in `target/debug/deps/` and `target/release/deps/`. `rustc` emits them (Makefile-style "this object depends on these files" lists) for incremental compilation, but cloc sees the `.d` extension and assumes the D programming language.

Fix: exclude `target/` when running cloc.

```
cloc . --exclude-dir=target
```

Or more generally, since `target/` shouldn't ever be counted (it's all build output):

```
cloc . --vcs=git
```

That uses `git ls-files`, so it only counts tracked files and naturally skips anything in `.gitignore` (which already excludes `target/`).

Quick sanity check — with `--vcs=git` you'll get the real picture:
